subject.title: feat: expose rawBody on user messages in plugin hook events

question: Should OpenClaw accept `rawBody` on `before_prompt_build`, `before_agent_start`, and `agent_end` as a public provenance-gated plugin hook contract after the queue update-order bug is repaired?
rationale: The field is additive, but it becomes plugin API surface and a direct-user provenance boundary; automation can fix the ordering bug, but it cannot decide whether this is the permanent plugin contract maintainers want.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Fix the queued-steer update order, keep the docs/tests aligned, and let this additive hook field become the supported plugin API.

options.title: Defer to a broader inbound contract
options.body: Pause this PR and route plugin raw-input needs through the broader trusted inbound-decoration work if maintainers want one canonical surface.

options.title: Reject the rawBody hook field
options.body: Close or rework the PR if maintainers do not want hook events to carry a separate direct-user raw input field.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the queued-steer update order, keep the docs/tests aligned, and let this additive hook field become the supported plugin API.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent plugin hook API history makes this the strongest available owner signal for accepting or rejecting the new hook contract.
